## Definition of Ready (DoR) Gate Checklist

*Every pull request must carry its inputs before it can be merged. An engineering change without its inputs is not ready to build.*

---

### 1. Spec / PRD Reference
<!-- Link to PRD, Wiki page, or issue ticket. E.g. PRD-01 (AI Interview Behavior) or https://github.com/.../wiki/... -->
- **Spec Link**: 

### 2. Acceptance Criteria / Test Scenarios
<!-- Define what "done" looks like using Given/When/Then or specific verification criteria -->
- [ ] **Given**: 
- [ ] **When**: 
- [ ] **Then**: 

### 3. Solution / Design Plan
<!-- Short description of how this change is implemented and architectural decisions/trade-offs -->
- **Root Cause / Motivation**: 
- **Design / Approach**: 

### 4. Quality & Testing Verification
<!-- Automated tests are a hard precondition for any functional code changes -->
- [ ] Automated tests added/updated (Vitest or RSpec)
- [ ] Regression checks verified
- [ ] No checks weakened or deleted to force green
